description: Each modules/<name>/<version>/ directory is a published registry entry and never changes; a new version is a new directory, so Renovate reads nothing under modules/. ignorePaths, unlike a disabled packageRule, also keeps security updates out. It replaces config:recommended's list of ignored test directories; ci/tests/ holds only Python and Java, which no enabled manager reads

packageRules.description: The default branch here is main, which the preset's master rules do not match. Group patch and minor updates on main, as the preset does on master

Renovate merges the updates the preset labels automerge: security updates below a major version, except patched modules. It merges on a later run, once every check on the head commit has passed, not only the required ones, and the renovate-approve app has approved the pull request. Reviewers are still assigned, so one that fails reaches them.
